Brand guidelines

Version 1.4.0 · 2026-11-06 · Status: APPROVED by Leon Košak on 2026-11-06. The rules come from ADR 0001–0010.

1. One brand, two members

Nexavia is one product brand. Enterprise (web platform and the business mobile app) and Consumer (the household app, working name) are members of it, shown with a descriptor next to the logo. IoT, NOC, Lighting and Package are product tiers, not brands. KUEM appears only as the endorser in about, legal and trust contexts. ADR 0001, 0002

2. Logo

The supplied NEXAVIA logo is used unchanged: black on light surfaces, white on dark ones, or the supplied negative and cut-out files on solid backgrounds. Never redraw, respace, recolour, outline, stretch, add effects or set it in a font.

  • Member lockup: wordmark, a divider 0.034 H wide with a 0.41 H gap on each side, then the descriptor in Schibsted Grotesk Medium at 0.66 H in the member accent. H is the wordmark height.
  • Clear space: 0.5 H on every side (built into the SVG files).
  • Minimum size: wordmark at least 20 px high on screen and 6 mm in print. Below that, use the N icon (16 px or more).
  • Mono: one-colour lockups use the logo ink for every part.
ADR 0002, 0003 · files: dist/kit/logo, dist/kit/lockups

3. App icons

Enterprise uses the supplied N icon. Consumer uses the black N on a light tinted tile (#F1E4EC), white on #2A1A25 for dark icons. Tinted icons are a white glyph that iOS colours (shown here on grey). The two members stay distinct in greyscale. Android adaptive and monochrome layers are in dist/app-icons. ADR 0003

4. Colour

Accent is not status. Member accents mark the brand and primary actions only. Status colours are protected: no partner or tenant can change them, and they never carry brand meaning. Material dynamic colour stays off in native apps.

The token build checks 442 contrast pairs (both members, all four appearances) on every change: text, status and accent at least 4.5:1, or 7:1 in high contrast; control borders at least 3:1. ADR 0003, 0005 · dist/contrast-report.md

5. Typography

Schibsted Grotesk (SIL OFL 1.1) is the only Nexavia typeface, on web, Android, iOS and in PDFs. Partners cannot change it. System chrome (alerts, keyboard, pickers, share sheets, the iOS navigation bar) keeps the system font. If the font fails to load, the system font is the only fallback.

  • Scaling: all text follows the user's setting (rem, sp, Dynamic Type) up to 200 % and the largest accessibility size. Long values wrap or stack. Exceptions: bottom navigation labels stop at 150 % and stay on one line; tenant logo artwork is an image and does not scale.
  • Numbers: tables, lists and meter readings use tabular figures; a large single KPI uses proportional figures.
ADR 0002, 0003, 0006 F2

6. Icons

  • Web: Font Awesome Pro, Classic Regular, through the semantic registry (iconography/icon-registry.json), never by hard-coded icon names in components.
  • Status exception: Classic Solid only for status marks (critical, warning, OK, no data) at 16 px in dense grids and alarm lists.
  • Native: Font Awesome where it is technically suitable; otherwise SF Symbols on iOS and Material Symbols on Android, chosen by the same semantic icon IDs.
  • Font Awesome files are licensed and are never included in public assets or this kit.
ADR 0003, 0006 F1 · docs/09-FONTAWESOME-PRO.md

7. Light, dark and high contrast

Every surface ships in light and dark. High contrast (light HC and dark HC) switches on from the OS setting (prefers-contrast, Android 14+ contrast level, iOS Increase Contrast) and from a user setting on web and on Android 13. Windows forced colours keep system colours. ADR 0005

8. Tenants and partners

  • Tenant (the utility): name and optional logo only, in the tenant card under the product lockup on web and as a badge on mobile. The logo sits on a white plate in every appearance and is never recoloured; without a logo, initials. Tenants never get their own colours.
  • Partner (white label): a colour overlay that must pass the contrast gate and include high-contrast roles; status colours and the typeface stay Nexavia. Partner logos follow the lockup rules (SVG light and dark, 20 px minimum, 0.5 H clear space).
  • Powered by Nexavia: a text line in the web sidebar footer and at the bottom of the mobile Settings screen, only when the contract enables it.
ADR 0005 · W1–W9

9. Data in samples

Mockups, screenshots, samples and covers use only the synthetic fixture set: Komunala Vzorec d.o.o., Energetika Primer d.o.o., partner Aquadem, meter 4471-02, devices WM-1042xx / EM-2071xx / GW-30xx, roles instead of names, municipality-level places (Vzorčevo), @example.com addresses and dates in 2026. CI rejects e-mail addresses, phone numbers and street addresses. ADR 0006 F3

10. Starter kit

dist/kit holds the v1.0 files: master logo (supplied files), member lockups (SVG, PNG at 120 and 480 px height, light, dark, mono), store app icons (iOS 1024 px default, dark, tinted; Google Play 512 px), store screenshot frames (iPhone 6.9", Android phone) and link-preview images (1200×630). Print and slide templates come in later packages. Publishing any file to the public brand-assets repository needs a separate approval for that file. ADR 0006 F4, F5

11. Data colours

Charts with two or more series use one member-neutral palette. Categorical colours are assigned in this fixed order and follow the entity, never its rank; a ninth category becomes "Other". Sequential is one hue from little to much; diverging has a neutral midpoint. A single series keeps the member accent. Status colours are never series colours, and text never takes a series colour.

Colour-blind separation is at least 12.5 (ΔE) between neighbours in every mode. In light mode, sky and gold sit below 3:1 on the chart surface, so a chart with six or more series shows direct labels or a table. ADR 0007 U1

12. Product UI basics

  • States: empty, no results, error, offline and loading share one pattern: a neutral icon in a sunken circle, a title, one sentence, at most one action. Errors are not alarms and do not use the status red. Loading is a skeleton, shown after 300 ms.
  • Launch screens: canvas colour. Android keeps the adaptive launcher icon; iOS shows no logo.
  • Map markers: a pin with a 2 px ring; sites in the member accent; state by colour and glyph; selected at 125 % with a halo; clusters with a count.
  • Favicons, manifest, notifications: the approved icon tiles with the supplied N; manifest names are placeholders; the Android notification icon is the N as a flat silhouette with the member accent.
ADR 0007 U2–U5 · dist/ui

13. Illustration

"Instrument drawings": the product's own objects (cards, meter faces, charts, pins, calendars) drawn flat and front-on, one 2 px line weight, neutral planes and one accent element. No faces, gradients, 3D or IoT clipart; status colours never appear. For onboarding, first-run empty states, page not found and help; never in dense screens. Decorative: empty alt text.

ADR 0008 B1 · dist/illustrations

14. Motion

Motion explains a change and never decorates. Hover and press: fast (120 ms). Menus and popovers: base (200 ms) in, fast out. Dialogs and panels: slow (320 ms) in, base out. Standard easing for entering and moving, exit easing for leaving. Nothing loops; charts do not regrow on refresh; alarms never blink; the logo is never animated. Reduced motion makes everything instant. ADR 0003 tokens, ADR 0008 B2

15. Voice and tone

Calm, concrete and honest about data: value, unit, period, source and freshness, then what to do. No hype, no "real-time" unless it is, no exclamation marks, no blame. Slovenian is first-class (vikanje), with English and German (Sie) as equals. Formats come from the locale: 12,4 m³ · 6. 11. 2026 · 08.42 in Slovenian. One term list for all channels: odčitek / reading / Messwert, števec / meter / Zähler, opozorilo / alert / Warnung, ponudnik / provider / Versorger. ADR 0008 B3 · docs/proposals/brand-expression-v1.md

16. Photography

Optional and secondary. Real infrastructure and work in the region, daylight and neutral colour; no glow, neon or member-colour tints. People at work, faces only with a release. Screens in photos show only the synthetic fixture set. Text sits on a solid panel or a scrim of at least 60 %. Keep the subject in the central 80 % so one photo works in 3:2, 16:9, 1:1 and 4:5. ADR 0008 B4

17. Communication templates

Covers, slides, reports, e-mail, social and GitHub images are generated from the tokens, the supplied logo and one copy file in Slovenian, English and German. Edit the copy and regenerate; never redraw a template.

  • Covers (1920 × 1080): lockup, accent bar, title and subtitle left; a real product screen right.
  • Slides and reports: PowerPoint and Word templates whose theme carries the colours, the data palette and Schibsted Grotesk; install the font to edit them.
  • E-mail: 600 px, system font fallback, dark mode where supported, one button and a copyable link; the tenant is named in the text, never in the logo slot.
  • Social and GitHub: LinkedIn cover, announcement posts, organisation avatar and repository previews.
ADR 0009 · dist/templates

18. Fair and print

Table flag, roll-up, tent card and booth screen are generated from one specification file, so the printer's sizes, bleed and safe zones are swapped in and the files regenerated, never redrawn. The logo is the supplied vector, unchanged; text is Schibsted Grotesk; no screenshots and no licensed icons in print.

  • Table flag 210 × 140 mm, dark and light, both sides; the master logo alone, centred on the visible area.
  • Roll-up 850 × 2000 mm for Nexavia, Enterprise and Consumer in SL, EN and DE: logo and title in the top third, illustrations at eye level, the web address above the cassette.
  • Tent card A4 folded, Enterprise lockup and "Live demo" readable from both sides.
  • Booth screen 3840 × 2160 dark wallpaper with title and illustrations.
  • Files are sRGB; the printer converts to its CMYK or textile profile and supplies a proof. Check colour on the printed proof, not on screen.
ADR 0010 · dist/print · scripts/print/print-specs.json
